title: UPSSSC Veterinary Pharmacist Online Form 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
qualification: Veterinary Pharmacist diploma / as per UPSSSC notice
ageLimit: As published in the official notification
applicationFee: As published in the official notification
selectionProcess: Online application → Written exam / CBT / PET as notified → Document verification → Final merit

1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open the latest advertisement for UPSSSC Veterinary Pharmacist Online Form 2026
